pedal: Boss BF-3 Flanger, STANDARD only (mono: Guitar In -> Output A)
comment: Locked-control prospective validation. Six identical quiet sweeps bracketed by bypass and minimum-Res repeats. Manual/Depth/Rate stay physically untouched throughout. Fit timing from the first engaged take only; no per-take delay or gain adjustment for later engaged takes. Preserve stereo loopback for drift checks. All levels relative to the established rig reference; no new calibration performed by this plan.

takes.name: bypass-before-24
takes.note: STANDARD mode throughout. Set Manual 12:00, Depth and Rate fully counter-clockwise, Res minimum BEFORE this take. Guitar In -> Output A, nothing in B. Leave Manual, Depth, Rate and all interface gains untouched through the entire plan. Start bypassed.

takes.name: std-res-0700-before-24
takes.note: Switch on only. Keep the three fixed knobs untouched. This is the timing/gain reference; later Res responses will be predicted without re-fitting delay.

takes.name: std-res-0300-24
takes.note: Turn ONLY Res to the requested position. Do not touch Manual, Depth, Rate or interface gains. Wait until settled, then press Enter.

takes.name: std-res-0500-24
takes.note: Turn ONLY Res to the requested position. Do not touch Manual, Depth, Rate or interface gains. Wait until settled, then press Enter.

takes.name: std-res-0700-after-24
takes.note: Return ONLY Res to minimum. Do not reset or touch Manual, Depth or Rate. This repeat measures drift and repeatability.

takes.name: bypass-after-24
takes.note: Switch to bypass only. Leave every knob and interface gain untouched; final calibration reference.
